eyebrow.tone: cheerful intro with one emoji, sentence case (e.g. 'Classes start this Saturday!')

headline.tone: bouncy, enthusiastic; no exclamation mark here — save it for copy

subheadline.tone: warm, welcoming, one exclamation mark max

cta_primary.tone: action verb + energy (Join the fun, Book a spot, Shop now)

cta_secondary.tone: low-friction second option (See what's on, Learn more)
